name: Alchemy Absorption: Melody
source:
Silas is a 21-year-old with an adventuring spirit. He dreams of growing strong enough to explore dungeons, rare areas in his world that contain monsters and treasures. To achieve that, he is joined by his sister Asteria to attend the magic university, Celestial Academy. 

At the university, Silas meets and falls for Melody, one of his professors. However, he's not alone in that, not by a long shot. Melody is a dark fairy who constantly emits an aura that attracts people to her. Even though she's very flirtatious, she longs for a serious relationship with someone who won't just drool in her presence. Luckily for Silas, he's a bit more resistant to her aura than the average person. Will that be enough to win over Melody or will he end up with a broken heart just like everyone else who confesses to her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1439700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
塞拉斯是一个21岁的年轻人，具有冒险精神。他梦想变得足够强大，能够探索地牢，这是他世界中包含怪物和宝藏的稀有区域。为了实现这一目标，他与妹妹Asteria一起进入魔法大学天界学院学习。

在大学里，塞拉斯遇见并爱上了他的一位教授梅洛迪。然而，他并不是唯一一个这样做的人，而且绝对不是唯一一个这样做的人。Melody是一位黑暗精灵，不断散发出吸引人们的光环。尽管她非常轻浮，但她渴望与一个不会在她面前流口水的人建立认真的关系。对于塞拉斯来说幸运的是，他比普通人对她的光环有更强的抵抗力。这是否足以赢得梅洛迪的芳心，还是他会像其他向她告白的人一样，最终心碎呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1439700/]Steam[/url]]
